recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision reopens laboratory order catalog modeling across ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition.
issue_request: FHIR-10528 was Published/Persuasive for CDS and requested support for laboratory testing activities by adding ActivityDefinition.specimenRequirement [0..*] referencing SpecimenDefinition after SpecimenDefinition became available.
initial_application: The issue was applied at SVN 12592 by commit c890d2deb85cbdbc98047ae7f8e9b57cd09186c0, which added ActivityDefinition.specimenRequirement to the ActivityDefinition spreadsheet source as 0..* Reference(SpecimenDefinition) with lab-test definition and lab-order requirements text.
additional_context: SpecimenDefinition is active in current fhir.ini, satisfying the dependency from FHIR-10528/FHIR-10529. Current ActivityDefinition uses canonical(SpecimenDefinition), not Reference(SpecimenDefinition), because later Published issue FHIR-32751 explicitly changed specimenRequirement and the ObservationDefinition requirement elements to canonical; the existing FHIR-32751 reconciliation also aligned ModelInfo. Later issue FHIR-20553 withdrew a request to make specimenRequirement a backbone grouping structure after PlanDefinition was identified as the appropriate place for complex alternatives.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit is needed because source/activitydefinition/structuredefinition-ActivityDefinition.xml defines ActivityDefinition.specimenRequirement as a 0..* canonical to SpecimenDefinition, source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml agrees, and both ActivityDefinition and SpecimenDefinition are active current-build resources.

related_jiras.note: Created the SpecimenDefinition resource that FHIR-10528 depended on before updating ActivityDefinition.
Explicitly changed ActivityDefinition.specimenRequirement from Reference(SpecimenDefinition) to canonical(SpecimenDefinition), so the current datatype is intentional.
Rejected a later request to turn specimenRequirement into a backbone grouping structure, supporting the current simple repeated element.
